```{r}
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
methylation_clinical <- read.csv('brca_methylation_clinical.csv', row.names = 1)
betas <- read.csv('brca_methylation_betas.csv', row.names=1)
cpg_sites <- read.csv('brca_cpg_sites.csv', row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
#masking out samples that are not Metastatic or Primary solid Tumor
definition_mask <- methylation_clinical$definition %in% c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[definition_mask,]
betas_clean <- betas[,definition_mask]

#define your comparison and base group
primary_mask <- methylation_clinical$definition == "Primary solid Tumor"
methylation_clinical$metastatic <- !primary_mask

#fitting linear models using a "target value"
mval <- t(apply(betas_clean, 1, function(x) log2(x/(1-x)))) 

#fit linear models
design <- model.matrix(~ metastatic, data = methylation_clinical)
fit <- lmFit(mval, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
# Extracting model into dataframe
dat <- data.frame(foldchange = fit[["coefficients"]][,2], logPvalue =  -log10(p.adjust(fit2[["p.value"]][,2],method='BY')), geneName = cpg_sites$gene)

dat$threshold <- as.factor(abs(dat$foldchange) < 1)
```

```{r}
cols <- c("TRUE" = "grey", "FALSE" = "blue")

volcano_plot <- ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = foldchange, y = logPvalue, colour = threshold)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .2, size = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Fold Change") +
  ylab("-log10 p value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

write.csv(dat, "methylation_results_metastasis.csv")

ggsave(
  "/home1/byilmaz/490_cluster/week8_epigenomics/differential_methylation_volcano.png",
  plot = volcano_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#DESCRIPTION: The volcano plot shows more CpG sites with decreased methylation in metastatic samples than those with increased methylation when compared with Primary solid Tumor samples. Additionally, many of the CpG sites on the negative fold change side also exceed the significance threshold which means that there is more hypomethylation in the strong methylation differences associated with metastasis in the dataset. There were also some hypermethylated CpG sites in teh samples but they were less than the hypomethylated samples. This only shows an association between metastasis status and methylation changes.
